stem.text: Which mechanism accounts for the way most of the carbon dioxide is transported in blood?

A.text: Carbon dioxide dissolves in plasma and is carried in solution.

B.text: Carbon dioxide is converted to carbaminohaemoglobin inside red blood cells.

C.text: Carbon dioxide is converted to carboxyhaemoglobin inside red blood cells.

D.text: Carbon dioxide is converted to hydrogencarbonate ions inside red blood cells.
